notes.title: AVAILABLE NOW ON STEAM!!!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45529833/978c120518508a76280762efff72ec1bbf2daa06.png

SERRE IS FINALLY OUT ON STEAM!!!!

I made this game all the way back in 2017 for a game jam. Over the years people have asked me to put it on Steam, so they could more easily share it with their friends. That time has come. Thank you for your support all these years.

This game is short, and it is sweet, and I hope you have a lovely time with it! Please leave a review if you did, it would make my day!!!

The Artbook and Soundtrack are available as DLC, too! And they're even all in a bundle, so you can buy them all for 15% off! I hope you like them!

See you soon <3

-Adrienne
